items.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock on Our Watchlist and 2 We Avoid
items.summary: Mid-cap stocks often strike the right balance between having proven business models and market opportunities that can support $100 billion corporations. However, they face intense competition from scaled industry giants and can be disrupted by new innovative players vying for a slice of the pie.

items.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Verisk Analytics (VRSK) Raising Its Global Catastrophe Loss Benchmark To $171 Billion
items.summary: In August 2026, Verisk released its 2026 Global Modeled Catastrophe Losses Report, estimating that insurers should prepare for US$171 billion in average annual insured catastrophe losses, the highest figure it has reported so far.
